item.description: ### Fixed - **Amp stops saying "Approval required" once you've approved.** After an approval, the row kept asking while Amp got on with the work. It now reads "Working". - **Antigravity's finished alert is no longer lost.** A status update that arrived just after a turn ended could mark it as running again, so the finished alert never came. The turn now stays done. - **Cursor and Devin sessions show their conversation title again.** With hooks installed, an idle row read "Idle" instead of the title of the conversation.
